proof_body:
by
  intro x
  rw [← Zsqrtd.norm_eq_one_iff' (by norm_num), Zsqrtd.norm_def]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 : x.re * x.re + x.im * x.im = 1 := by linarith
    have hre : x.re ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x.im]
    have him : x.im ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x.re]
    have hre1 : -1 ≤ x.re ∧ x.re ≤ 1 := abs_le.mp (by simpa using abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' (a := x.re) (b := 1) (by simpa using hre) (by norm_num) |> fun h => abs_le.mpr h)
    have him1 : -1 ≤ x.im ∧ x.im ≤ 1 := abs_le.mp (by simpa using abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' (a := x.im) (b := 1) (by simpa using him) (by norm_num) |> fun h => abs_le.mpr h)
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := x
    simp only at h1 hre1 him1
    have ha : a = -1 ∨ a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by omega
    have hb : b = -1 ∨ b = 0 ∨ b = 1 := by omega
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp_all [Zsqrtd.ext_iff]
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl) <;> simp
target_source: ∀ (x : GaussianInt), IsUnit x ↔ x = 1 ∨ x = -1 ∨ x = ⟨0, 1⟩ ∨ x = ⟨0, -1⟩
